annotations.title: Cancel a message that hasn't been sent yet

description: Remove a waiting message before its send begins. The answer says whether its message quota was returned. Any new-conversation budget it reserved is released too. A send that has already begun cannot be cancelled. The id is the one the send call returned. Free.

id.description: Id of the queued message, from the send call's answer.
